description: Get a single implementation packet for one page URL. Useful when you want to batch-fix one page at a time. Returns the same shape as a single entry in implement_approved_pins.packets — pins, aggregated selectors, suggested branch, traceability config. Matches by exact URL or partial substring.

pageUrl.description: The page URL to fetch the packet for (exact match or substring, case-insensitive).

projectId.description: Optional project ID to scope the search. Without projectId it uses the folder's default project: the one set with --project-id / PINCUSHION_PROJECT_ID, else the one confirmed with confirm_project_setup for this folder and the signed-in account, else the single project auto-discovered by URL; with none of those it reads every project. If the folder's selection file exists but cannot be read, it returns setup_selection_unreadable instead of reading.

name: get_implementation_packet
title: Implementation Packet
